cards.title: Matrix and Analyte Specificity in Visualization
cards.claim: Plasma, tissue homogenate, and lavage fluid concentrations must be plotted on separate panels or axes due to incompatible units (e.g., mg/L vs mass/g tissue). Whole-lung homogenate is not automatically ELF. Unmatched samples cannot establish tissue/plasma ratios.
limitations: Do not connect unrelated matrices as a biological time trajectory
Corrected and measured values require distinct labels
cards.downstream_use: Exposure-target comparison and tissue distribution analysis.

note: Method/reference scope retained; source identity is available in original evidence.
